newsitem.title: USA: Texaco says to boost earnings, production.
newsitem.headline: Texaco says to boost earnings, production.

text.p: Texaco Inc said it is on track to meet its profit and production objectives.

"We are well on track for meeting the ambitious goals we set for ourselves, to maintain a strong balance sheet, increase production from 1.1 million barrels to 1.6 million barrels per day," Texaco chairman and chief executive Peter Bijur said in a statement.

Bijur said the company is on track to achieve a 15 percent or better return on stockholders' equity, deliver return on average capital employed of at least 13 percent and more than double its 1995 earnings by the year 2000.
Bijur made his comments at Texaco's annual shareholders meeting.
Several protesters called on the company to improve its treatment of minorities and divest its operations in Burma.
